headline: Sensex crashes over 1,200 points from day's high as Nifty slips below 22,400 amid broad market sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex plummeted over 1,200 points from intraday highs due to heavy profit booking and market volatility.
Broader markets tumbled significantly, with smallcap and midcap indices falling up to 4%.
Rising crude oil prices, topping $113 per barrel, weighed heavily on market sentiment.
Metal sector faced sharp selling pressure, with the metal index dropping 3%.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 700 points while Nifty 50 tested the 22,400 level.
Jio Platforms IPO Day 3 saw strong demand with QIB bids at 15.95 times and a 22% grey market premium.
SBI informed affected customers individually following a reported data breach.
Gold prices crashed by Rs 9,700 in 10 days, falling below Rs 1,42,000.
summary: Indian benchmark indices suffered a steep decline today as Sensex crashed over 1,200 points from its intraday high, pulling Nifty below 22,400. Midcap and smallcap stocks faced severe selling pressure, dropping up to 4%. On the primary market front, Jio Platforms IPO recorded strong institutional participation on Day 3.
